main_text.l: per. Cur autem potiare, mi fili, alienâ? cur
in gremio non tua hæreas? cùm ob oculos
positas habeat Iova vias hominis, & eius
gressus libret omnes. Ipse suis criminibus

l.i: nit, bonum invenit, & Iova favorem ob-
sed intelligens uxor à Iova est. Prover-
Præbe mihi, mi fili, tuam mentem, o-
angustaq; scrobs mulier aliena. Ea sanè
num perfidos conficit. Cui heu? cui heu?

page.notes: Page is clean. The catchword "cui" is at the lower right. The first word "per." is a fragment continuing from the previous page. "alienâ?" and "Præbe" are uncertain readings in the scan. "restibus" is read as printed. Section numbers LXXXI to LXXXIII are bare numbers and are written as paragraphs.
